description:
Model a real estate investment property in Portfolio Performance. A portfolio file is already open with a 350,000 EUR cash balance.

1. Create a new security named 'Oak Street Rental Property' (Currency: EUR, no ticker/ISIN needed).
2. Record the purchase of this property on 2024-01-15: 1 share at 285,000 EUR (Total: 285,000 EUR).
3. Record rental income as 'Dividend' payments of 1,200 EUR each for the first of every month from February to July 2024 (6 payments total).
4. Add two manual historical price entries to track the property value: 288,000 EUR on 2024-03-31 and 291,500 EUR on 2024-06-30.
5. Save the portfolio file.
